title: Kettlebell Row
summary: A one-arm row with a kettlebell, supported on a bench or in a staggered stance.

muscles.why: Library rating 0.9 for lats (main mover): each working set adds 0.9 of a set to the weekly lats total.
Library rating 0.8 for upper back (main mover): each working set adds 0.8 of a set to the weekly upper back total.
Library rating 0.5 for biceps (helper): each working set adds 0.5 of a set to the weekly biceps total.
Library rating 0.4 for rear delts (helper): each working set adds 0.4 of a set to the weekly rear delts total.
Library rating 0.4 for traps (helper): each working set adds 0.4 of a set to the weekly traps total.

setup.text: Brace one hand on a bench and hold the bell with your arm straight.

form_cues.cue: Row the bell toward your hip
Pull your elbow back toward your hip, not straight up.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds up to 2 ramp-up sets only when the load is heavy for the equipment and the main muscle is not warm yet.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 7.5% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 8-12 reps, stopping about 3 reps short of failure (RIR 3). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train pain-free.

alternatives.why: Similar muscles; dumbbell instead of kettlebell.
Swap sheet: More stretch emphasis, More systemic fatigue.
Swap sheet: Upper-back thickness focus, More stable, Both sides together.
Swap sheet: More stretch emphasis, More stable, Steadier cable tension.
